world.title: US-Iran War: Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei to Be Buried Shortly at Imam Reza Shrine in Mashhad
world.summary: Ayatollah Ali Khamenei's burial is set to occur at the Imam Reza Shrine in Mashhad, following large funeral processions in Iraq. Concurrently, Israeli airstrikes in Gaza and Lebanon have resulted in at least eight fatalities in Gaza and two in Lebanon. Air raid sirens have been activated in Bahrain, with Kuwait reporting missile and drone attacks.

world.title: 'American jobs ought to go to American workers': JD Vance as US cracks down on H-1B fraud
world.summary: US Vice President JD Vance announced a crackdown on alleged H-1B visa fraud, emphasizing that "American jobs ought to go to American workers and not foreign fraudsters." This initiative aims to address misuse of the visa program. Vance's statement reflects a broader effort by the US government to prioritize domestic employment and ensure the integrity of immigration policies.

world.title: tinted glasses': Russia reacts to US Patriot missile licence for Ukraine
world.summary: Russia responded to the U.S. granting Ukraine a license to manufacture Patriot missile interceptors, stating it does not hold "rose-tinted glasses" regarding the situation. The Kremlin expressed that it is under "no illusion" about the implications of this decision. This reaction highlights ongoing tensions between Russia and the U.S. concerning military support for Ukraine amid the conflict.

business.title: Stocks to Watch Today: TCS, IC Electricals, Anand Rathi Wealth, Dixon Tech, Vikram Solar, Havells, Pace Digitek, Power Grid in focus on 10 July
business.summary: On July 10, several stocks will be in focus, including Tata Consultancy Services, Anand Rathi Wealth, Muthoot Microfin, Dixon Technologies, Vikram Solar, and Power Grid Corporation of India. Other notable mentions are Havells India, Torrent Pharmaceuticals, Container Corporation of India, GAIL India, Pace Digitek, Unichem Laboratories, Sunteck Realty, and IC Electricals Company, highlighting significant market activity.

business.title: Apple's Mac sales grew while most PC makers saw drops in Q2
business.summary: In the second quarter of this year, Apple was the only major computer manufacturer to increase sales, with Mac shipments rising by 10.1% compared to the previous year. This growth contrasts sharply with most other PC makers, which experienced declines in sales. According to IDC research, Apple's performance highlights its unique position in the current computer market landscape.

business.title: BSNL launches satellite phone priced at ₹1.34 lakh: Who can buy it and what makes it special?
business.summary: Bharat Sanchar Nigam Limited (BSNL) has introduced a satellite phone priced at ₹1.34 lakh, aimed at users in defence, maritime, and disaster response sectors. The device is designed for challenging environments, expanding BSNL's product offerings. The launch highlights BSNL's commitment to providing communication solutions in areas where traditional networks may be unavailable or unreliable.

technology.title: iQOO 16 may not launch in India due to rising memory prices
technology.summary: iQOO 16 may not launch in India due to increasing memory hardware costs. The company is reportedly considering introducing a budget Z-series smartphone instead. The iQOO 16 had generated speculation about its release following its debut in China, but the rising prices of components could impact its availability in the Indian market this year.

technology.title: I was shocked by how much cheaper it is to buy discs over digital
technology.summary: A recent analysis highlights that purchasing physical video game discs is often significantly cheaper than buying digital versions. Despite the industry's shift towards digital media, particularly by companies like Sony, the price disparity remains notable. By 2028, Sony plans to cease disc releases for PlayStation, raising concerns about the future affordability of gaming for consumers.

technology.title: Nothing Phone 4b RCB Edition Hits OLX at 2x Its Launch Price
technology.summary: The Nothing Phone 4b RCB Edition has been listed on OLX at double its launch price. Co-founder Carl Pei has responded to the listing. The special edition features a new color scheme inspired by the Royal Challengers Bangalore (RCB) but retains the same internal hardware and software as the standard model. This release coincides with Nothing's two-year anniversary.

sports.title: India forced into changes for Bristol decider
sports.summary: India has made two changes for the final T20I against England in Bristol due to injuries to key bowlers. Fast bowler Harshit Rana and spinner Varun Chakravarthy will miss the remainder of the series. England aims for a historic series win, while India adjusts its lineup in response to these setbacks ahead of the decisive match.

sports.title: Harshit Rana, Varun Chakaravarthy ruled out of final two England T20Is with hamstring injuries
sports.summary: Harshit Rana and Varun Chakaravarthy have been ruled out of the final two T20Is against England due to hamstring injuries sustained during the third match at Trent Bridge. The Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) confirmed the assessment by their medical team. Washington Sundar and Prasidh Krishna have been named as replacements for the fourth T20I.

sports.title: Muchova saves match point to beat Gauff, reach first Wimbledon final
sports.summary: Karolina Muchova defeated Coco Gauff in a thrilling Wimbledon semifinal, saving a match point to win 6-2, 1-6, 7-6 (12-10). This victory marks Muchova's first Grand Slam final appearance and keeps alive the possibility of an all-Czech final. Gauff's remarkable tournament run ended with this match, highlighting the competitive nature of the event.

health.title: Global cancer cases projected to reach nearly 35 million by 2050
health.summary: The World Health Organization (WHO) reports that global cancer cases are projected to reach nearly 35 million by 2050. Currently, cancer claims over 26,000 lives daily, impacting millions physically, emotionally, and financially. The report highlights the growing burden of the disease, emphasizing the urgent need for effective prevention and treatment strategies to address this escalating health crisis.

health.title: Cardiovascular-Kidney-Metabolic Syndrome: What To Know
health.summary: Cardiovascular-Kidney-Metabolic Syndrome affects midlife women, linking heart health, metabolism, and kidney function. Conditions such as diabetes, obesity, high blood pressure, and chronic kidney disease increase the risk of developing this syndrome. Understanding the interconnections between these organs is crucial for managing health and preventing complications. Awareness and proactive measures can help mitigate risks associated with this syndrome.

health.title: Weight-loss drugs are linked to a slew of health benefits - but may not make you happy, study finds
health.summary: Research from the University of Chicago indicates that weight-loss drugs like Ozempic and Wegovy, while effective for weight reduction and linked to various health benefits, may not necessarily enhance happiness or mental well-being. The study followed thousands of users, revealing that despite physical improvements, the emotional impacts of these medications remain uncertain and warrant further investigation in this emerging field.

science.title: Hummingbirds and pineapples: Why this ancient relationship hits the evolutionary sweetspot
science.summary: Bromeliads, a unique plant family, create miniature ecosystems in rainforest canopies by forming tiny ponds in their leaves. These ponds host frogs, insects, microbes, and crustaceans. Bromeliads include air plants and the "Queen of the Andes," a towering species. They also produce pineapples, highlighting the intricate relationships between plants and wildlife in these high-altitude environments.

science.title: Birdlike robot swims underwater, then flaps into flight without paddling
science.summary: Engineers have developed a birdlike robot capable of swimming underwater and transitioning to flight without paddling. Inspired by diving birds such as loons, gulls, puffins, and petrels, the robot mimics their ability to dive for prey and take off into the air. This innovation aims to enhance robotic mobility in both aquatic and aerial environments.

science.title: Why tissues refuse to move, and how that matters for healing & cancer
science.summary: A study from IISc reveals that mechanochemical feedback among neighboring cells contributes to glass-like rigidity in epithelial tissues. This rigidity is crucial for coordinated cell movement during wound healing. Disruption of this coordination can facilitate cancer spread. The findings provide valuable insights into the processes of healing, cancer development, and embryonic tissue balance, highlighting the importance of cellular interactions.

entertainment.title: Cocktail 2 Box Office: Shahid Kapoor, Kriti Sanon, and Rashmika Mandanna starrer adds Rs 4.50 crore in Week 3, nets Rs 84 crore in 21 days
entertainment.summary: Cocktail 2, featuring Shahid Kapoor, Kriti Sanon, and Rashmika Mandanna, has generated Rs 84 crore in 21 days, adding Rs 4.50 crore in its third week. The film's box office performance has significantly declined, with a 70 percent drop from the previous week. It is projected to conclude its run with a total of Rs 85-86 crore nett in India.

entertainment.title: Akshay Kumar expresses concern as Rajesh Sharma rushed to the hospital after insect bite on the set of Prabhas starrer 'Fauzi', prays for his recovery
entertainment.summary: Actor Akshay Kumar has voiced concern for veteran actor Rajesh Sharma, who was hospitalized after a suspected insect bite while filming Prabhas' movie 'Fauji' at Ramoji Film City in Hyderabad. Kumar expressed his worries on social media, sharing prayers for Sharma's swift recovery. The incident occurred during the shoot, prompting immediate medical attention for the affected actor.
